societes.title: Delivery companies
societes.help: Delivery companies (with or without an API) and their rates (what they charge you). Companies with an API are connected in “API Integration”. Your own couriers are in “Couriers”.

api.title: API Integration
api.help: Pick a company and paste the keys of your account there. Each connection creates a delivery company: parcels are created there in one click and statuses update by themselves. You can connect several accounts of the same company.
api.none: No account connected: pick a company above.
api.noMatch: No company is called « {{q}} ». If yours has an API, pick « Other API ».

form.name: Name
form.keySaved: Key saved: leave empty to keep it.

custom.testPath: Path to test the connection (GET, optional)
custom.bodyHint: {{…}} are replaced with the order details. Without quotes around: number or true/false.
custom.trackingPath: Where the tracking number is in the answer
custom.statusPath: Where the status is in the answer
custom.statusesAfter: Link the company's statuses to yours with the “Statuses” button of the list, after saving.

fees.title: Rates · {{name}}
fees.help: What the company charges you per wilaya: home delivery, stop desk and return fee. Used to compute the net in the cash page.
fees.fillHint: Tip: type a price in a column header then Enter to fill the empty cells.

desks.title: Stop desks · {{name}}
desks.name: Desk
desks.codeHint: Desk id in the company's API

statuses.title: Statuses · {{name}}
statuses.help: What each status of the company means for you. “Automatic” follows the built-in mapping; pick a status to override it.
statuses.empty: No known status yet: send parcels then update.

preview.title: Send preview · {{name}}
preview.help: What would be sent to the company for an order (nothing is sent). Keys are masked.

livreurs.title: Couriers
livreurs.help: Your couriers: create their account in Users with the Courier role. They see their parcels in “My round”. “End of round” sorts their route sheet: farthest first, coming back here.
livreurs.none: No courier: create an account with the Courier role in Users.
livreurs.endHint: Sorts the parcels: farthest first, coming back here.

zr.title: {{name}} from Pilotix
zr.hookHelp: {{name}} tells Pilotix about every status change of a parcel: no more waiting for the automatic update (every 5 minutes).
zr.hookOnDone: {{name}} will tell Pilotix about every status change

does.send: Parcels created at {{name}} as soon as they go to dispatch
does.labels: {{name}}’s labels: all in a single PDF
does.bags: Pickup bags made and printed in Dépôt › Dispatchées
does.changes: Modification requests (price, home ↔ stop desk, address, phone) from each parcel
does.exchanges: SAV exchanges sent as {{name}} exchanges, with their return
does.journey: Journey, SMS, driver and the customer’s return risk on each parcel
does.pay: Payments: request, date, received into the cash box

ph.missing_one: {{count}} company without API keys: its parcels are not sent automatically.
ph.missing_other: {{count}} companies without API keys: their parcels are not sent automatically.
ph.manualSub: You create the parcels at the company by hand, then enter the tracking number.
ph.sheetSub: Parcels to hand to the courier, to print
ph.feesSub: Price per wilaya, home and desk
ph.testSub: Check that the API keys work
ph.previewSub: What will be sent for a parcel
ph.editSubApi: Name, API keys, active or not
ph.addKeys: API keys missing: tap to add them
ph.apiHelp: Connect a company with its API keys: Pilotix sends it the parcels and follows their statuses by itself.

live.title: {{name}} from Pilotix
live.poll: {{name}} has no webhook: Pilotix asks it for your parcels’ statuses every {{n}} minutes, on its own.
live.manualHelp: {{name}} tells Pilotix about every status change. Turn it on, then paste the address given into your {{name}} space (Développement → Webhooks).
live.paste: Paste this address into your {{name}} space → Développement → Webhooks (once):

does.change: Change a parcel’s price, address or phone
does.cancel: Cancel a parcel not picked up yet
does.exchange: Send an exchange (product to bring back)
does.retry: Ask for a new delivery try
does.label: Print {{name}}’s label

prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.help: Your choices for the whole shop.
prefs.openHint: Open advanced mode to change a choice.
prefs.manualDefault: In Manual, the default company counts
prefs.manualDefaultHint: The agent confirms: the order goes to the company on the card. If off, it waits in « À attribuer ».
prefs.changeHint: By hand, on one order. Admins always can.
prefs.strictLockHint: An order placed by a strict rule: only agent managers and admins change it.
prefs.rules: Who can change the Pilot rules
prefs.rulesHint: The Pilot Auto Assign rules (Delivery companies › Pilot Auto Assign). Others see them without changing them. Admins always can.
prefs.backupHint: A private order that waits too long goes to this company, if it delivers there.
prefs.noStockHint: An out-of-stock order that waits too long rings an alert.

sum.manualOn: It goes when the agent confirms.
sum.manualOff: The order waits in « À attribuer ».
sum.strictOff: No, anyone allowed can change them.

alerts.title: Suivi alerts
alerts.hint: When the company or the livreur gives one of these statuses, the parcel goes to Suivi › Alerts: a suivi agent calls the customer before it comes back.
alerts.coHint_one: {{count}} status sends to Alerts. Tap to choose.
alerts.coHint_other: {{count}} statuses send to Alerts. Tap to choose.
alerts.none: No statuses: this company has no API.
alerts.clockHint: The same for every company and your livreurs. In working hours (your call slots): nights do not count.
alerts.clockSum: 1st call within {{first}} h, solved within {{solve}} h

pilot.title: Pilot Auto Assign
pilot.autoHint: Your rules choose each order's company as soon as it arrives, and again if the agent changes the commune or the products. A strict rule beats a soft one.
pilot.manualHint: Your team chooses the company on each order. The default company is filled in first (see Preferences).
pilot.readOnly: Only admins and the people chosen in Preferences change these rules.
pilot.rulesHint: A rule = wilayas, communes and/or products → a company or “Private delivery”.
pilot.empty: No rule yet: every order goes to the default company.
pilot.privateHint: Your own drivers: a manager chooses who delivers.
pilot.warnOff: {{co}} is switched off: this rule is skipped.
pilot.warnServe_one: {{co}} has no price in {{count}} of these wilayas: there, the next rule decides.
pilot.warnServe_other: {{co}} has no price in {{count}} of these wilayas: there, the next rule decides.
pilot.clashesHint: One order can fall into two rules. Pilot remembers your answer: you can change it here.
pilot.whereHint: One or more wilayas, or a region in one click.
pilot.communesHint: Pick communes to take only them. No commune: the whole wilaya.
pilot.manyW: Communes can be picked for 12 wilayas at most.
pilot.productsHint: No product: every product. With products: orders holding one of them.
pilot.softHint: A strict rule comes before it.
pilot.liveAsk: Crosses rule {{n}} ({{co}}): {{ex}}. You will choose who wins when saving.
pilot.askHelp: These rules can take the same order. Choose once: Pilot remembers it.
pilot.moveHelp: These orders are not prepared yet. With your new rules, they would go to another company.
pilot.moveNever: Never moved: orders already sent, given by hand, or waiting in “To assign”.
pilot.testHint: With the rules on screen, even unsaved.
pilot.warnServeNames: {{co}} does not deliver here (no price): {{list}}. There, the next rule decides.
pilot.missT_one: {{co}} does not deliver to {{count}} of these wilayas
pilot.missT_other: {{co}} does not deliver to {{count}} of these wilayas
pilot.missWhy: This company has no price for these wilayas: it would refuse the parcels.

cov.title: Coverage
cov.help: Where each company delivers, wilaya by wilaya. Pilot and confirmation follow these choices.
cov.refreshed_one: Rates and desks updated for {{count}} company.
cov.refreshed_other: Rates and desks updated for {{count}} companies.
cov.freeHint: Everywhere to start with: switch off the wilayas it does not go to.
cov.listHint: To start with, its own list: the wilayas where it has a price. Tap a wilaya to switch it on or off.
cov.warnTip: {{co}} has no price here: parcels may be refused.
cov.askOn: {{co}} has no price for {{w}}. It may refuse the parcels. Switch it on anyway?
cov.askOnMany: {{co}} has no price for {{count}} of these wilayas. It may refuse the parcels. Switch them on anyway?
cov.reset_one: Back to the company's list ({{count}} change)
cov.reset_other: Back to the company's list ({{count}} changes)
cov.fixHint: What keeps Pilot from choosing well.
cov.noFees: Rates not imported yet: tap “Update now” or fill them in by hand.

custom.title: Other API
custom.sub: Any other company that has an API
